title: PrepareRequest
description: Optional scope for IndeRunApi.prepare (ADR 019). Every field is optional: an empty request covers every registered provider and task. It carries no user content.

requestId.description: Fixes the run id, for correlation.

tasks.description: Task kinds to prepare. Absent means every task a registered provider can prepare.

locale.description: BCP 47 tag of the language to prepare. Absent lets a speech provider use the device's own language.

voice.title: PrepareVoice
voice.description: A voice to prepare, as for a speech request.

id.description: A voice id read from listVoices().

allowDownload.description: Lets this call start a platform's own download, whatever autoDownload says at registration. Call it from a user's decision. Absent follows autoDownload.

privacy.description: The privacy policy of the runs this precedes.
